description: This file is a shell script that appears to be a test suite for a Git ref store API, utilizing shell commands to perform setup, ref creation, deletion, renaming, and verification, among other Git operations.

methods.name: create-symref
methods.description: Creates a symbolic reference in Git.

methods.name: for-each-ref
methods.description: Iterates over references matching a pattern.

methods.name: resolve-ref
methods.description: Resolves a reference to its SHA1.

methods.name: verify-ref
methods.description: Verifies the existence and validity of a ref.

methods.name: for-each-reflog-ent
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries for a specific ref.

methods.name: for-each-reflog-ent-reverse
methods.description: Iterates over reflog entries in reverse order.

methods.name: reflog-exists
methods.description: Checks if a reflog exists for a ref.

methods.name: delete-reflog
methods.description: Deletes the reflog for a ref.

methods.name: create-reflog
methods.description: Creates a reflog for a ref.

methods.name: update-ref
methods.description: Updates a Git reference to a certain SHA1.
